Glossary of Brazil investigative terms.fact: A court of second instance is analogous to a Court of appeals or appellate court in Anglo-Saxon jurisprudence.

Glossary of Brazil investigative terms.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy

Glossary of Brazil investigative terms.fact: Usage note: There isn't sufficient usage in English sources to have settled on one term for this, but "bribery department" is present in a BBC report. known in English as the "Atibaia case" or "Atibaia site", and other terms.

Glossary of Brazil investigative terms.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy

Glossary of Brazil investigative terms.fact: Sítio de Atibaia lit., "the Atibaia site". known in English as the "Atibaia case" or "Atibaia site", and other terms.

Glossary of Brazil investigative terms.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
Glossary of Brazil investigative terms.question: In context after a first use, the property is also referred to as the "ranch", the "house", the "farmhouse", the "case", the "site case", etc.; and in _____, sometimes as the "sítio Santa Bárbara"
Glossary of Brazil investigative terms.fact: In context after a first use, the property is also called the "ranch", the "house", the "farmhouse", the "case", the "site case", etc.; and in Portuguese, sometimes as the "sítio Santa Bárbara".

The formal owner of the property was Fernando Bittar, ex-colleague of Fabio Luis Lula da Silva (Lulinha), son of Lula.

Glossary of Brazil investigative terms.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
Glossary of Brazil investigative terms.question: STF abbreviation for _____
Glossary of Brazil investigative terms.fact: STF abbreviation for Supremo Tribunal Federal.

Glossary of Brazil investigative terms.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
Glossary of Brazil investigative terms.question: STJ abbreviation for _____ de Justiça
Glossary of Brazil investigative terms.fact: STJ abbreviation for Superior Tribunal de Justiça. Superior Tribunal de Justiça see STJ; Superior Court of Justice Superior Court of Justice, also called the STJ.

Glossary of Brazil investigative terms.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
Glossary of Brazil investigative terms.question: Superfaturamento see _____, especially on a government project with corrupt intent
Glossary of Brazil investigative terms.fact: Superfaturamento see Superfaturamento Overbilling, especially on a government project with corrupt intent.

Glossary of Brazil investigative terms.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
Glossary of Brazil investigative terms.question: The Federal Police indicated in a _____ report that around R$700 million ($180 million) was overbilled in 300 public works projects, and that of every 100 Reals spent, on average R$29 were overbilled
Glossary of Brazil investigative terms.fact: The Federal Police indicated in a 2010 report that around R$700 million ($180 million) was overbilled in 300 public works projects, and that of every 100 Reals spent, on average R$29 were overbilled.

Glossary of Brazil investigative terms.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
Glossary of Brazil investigative terms.question: Superior Tribunal de Justiça see STJ; Superior Court of _____ of Justice, also known as the STJ
Glossary of Brazil investigative terms.fact: Superior Tribunal de Justiça see STJ; Superior Court of Justice Superior Court of Justice, also called the STJ.

Glossary of Brazil investigative terms.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy

Glossary of Brazil investigative terms.fact: Justices in STJ (as in other Superior Courts) are called "minister" not "justices" or "judges"; not to be confused however, with ministers from the executive branch.

Glossary of Brazil investigative terms.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
Glossary of Brazil investigative terms.question: Supremo Tribunal Federal see _____; pt:Supremo Tribunal Federal The Supreme Federal Court is the highest Court in Brazil, and is considered a court of third instance
Glossary of Brazil investigative terms.fact: Supremo Tribunal Federal see Supreme Federal Court; pt:Supremo Tribunal Federal The Supreme Federal Court is the highest Court in Brazil, and is considered a court of third instance.

Glossary of Brazil investigative terms.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
Glossary of Brazil investigative terms.question: TCE-RJ see also TCE-RJ An abbreviation for pt:_____ de Contas do Estado do Rio de Janeiro
Glossary of Brazil investigative terms.fact: Supremo Tribunal Federal see Supreme Federal Court; pt:Supremo Tribunal Federal The Supreme Federal Court is the highest Court in Brazil, and is considered a court of third instance. Glossary of Brazil investigative terms.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
Glossary of Brazil investigative terms.question: Terceira instância _____, "third instance" (see instância)
Glossary of Brazil investigative terms.fact: Terceira instância Literally, "third instance" (see instância).

Glossary of Brazil investigative terms.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
Glossary of Brazil investigative terms.question: There is no third instance of the judiciary branch defined in the _____
Glossary of Brazil investigative terms.fact: There is no third instance of the judiciary branch defined in the Constitution. They are set up by articles 107 and 108 of the Constitution.

Glossary of Brazil investigative terms.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
Glossary of Brazil investigative terms.question: However, the _____ are sometimes known informally as the "third instance", because decisions taken by tribunals of the first and second instances can be reviewed by superior courts
Glossary of Brazil investigative terms.fact: However, the Superior Tribunals are sometimes known informally as the "third instance", because decisions taken by tribunals of the first and second instances can be reviewed by superior courts.

Glossary of Brazil investigative terms.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
Glossary of Brazil investigative terms.question: There are six regional federal courts, each covering several _____ states
Glossary of Brazil investigative terms.fact: There are six regional federal courts, each covering several Brazilian states.

Glossary of graph theory.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
Glossary of graph theory.question: α For a graph G, α(G) (using the _____ letter alpha) is its independence number (see independent), and α′(G) is its matching number (see matching)
Glossary of graph theory.fact: α For a graph G, α(G) (using the Greek letter alpha) is its independence number (see independent), and α′(G) is its matching number (see matching).

Glossary of graph theory.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
Glossary of graph theory.question: anti-edge _____ for non-edge, a pair of non-adjacent vertices
Glossary of graph theory.fact: anti-edge Synonym for non-edge, a pair of non-adjacent vertices.

Glossary of graph theory.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
Glossary of graph theory.question: arborescence _____ for a rooted and directed tree; see tree
Glossary of graph theory.fact: Synonym for universal vertex, a vertex adjacent to all other vertices. arborescence Synonym for a rooted and directed tree; see tree.

Glossary of graph theory.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
Glossary of graph theory.question: biclique _____ for complete bipartite graph or complete bipartite subgraph; see complete
Glossary of graph theory.fact: biclique Synonym for complete bipartite graph or complete bipartite subgraph; see complete. biconnected Usually a synonym for 2-vertex-connected, but sometimes includes K2 though it is not 2-connected.

Glossary of graph theory.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
Glossary of graph theory.question: biconnected _____ a synonym for 2-vertex-connected, but sometimes includes K2 though it is not 2-connected
Glossary of graph theory.fact: biconnected Usually a synonym for 2-vertex-connected, but sometimes includes K2 though it is not 2-connected.

Glossary of graph theory.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
Glossary of graph theory.question: A block graph (also called a clique tree if connected, and sometimes erroneously called a _____ tree) is a graph all of whose blocks are complete graphs
Glossary of graph theory.fact: A block graph (also called a clique tree if connected, and sometimes erroneously called a Husimi tree) is a graph all of whose blocks are complete graphs.

Glossary of graph theory.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
Glossary of graph theory.question: Another type of graph, also called a book, or a quadrilateral book, is a collection of 4-cycles joined at a shared edge; the _____ product of a star with an edge
Glossary of graph theory.fact: Another type of graph, also called a book, or a quadrilateral book, is a collection of 4-cycles joined at a shared edge; the Cartesian product of a star with an edge.

Glossary of graph theory.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
Glossary of graph theory.question: cactus A cactus graph, cactus tree, cactus, or _____ tree is a connected graph in which each edge belongs to at most one cycle
Glossary of graph theory.fact: cactus A cactus graph, cactus tree, cactus, or Husimi tree is a connected graph in which each edge belongs to at most one cycle.

Glossary of graph theory.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
Glossary of graph theory.question: If, in addition, each vertex belongs to at most two blocks, then it is called a _____ cactus
Glossary of graph theory.fact: If, in addition, each vertex belongs to at most two blocks, then it is called a Christmas cactus.

Glossary of graph theory.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
Glossary of graph theory.question: χ χ(G) (using the _____ letter chi) is the chromatic number of G and χ ′(G) is its chromatic index; see chromatic and coloring
Glossary of graph theory.fact: χ χ(G) (using the Greek letter chi) is the chromatic number of G and χ ′(G) is its chromatic index; see chromatic and coloring.

Glossary of graph theory.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
Glossary of graph theory.question: chromatic _____ to do with coloring; see color
Glossary of graph theory.fact: chromatic Having to do with coloring; see color.

Glossary of graph theory.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
Glossary of graph theory.question: circuit A circuit may refer to a closed trail or an element of the cycle space (an _____ spanning subgraph)
Glossary of graph theory.fact: circuit A circuit may refer to a closed trail or an element of the cycle space (an Eulerian spanning subgraph).

Glossary of graph theory.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
Glossary of graph theory.question: The graph is _____ if and only if its circumference equals its order
Glossary of graph theory.fact: The graph is Hamiltonian if and only if its circumference equals its order.

Glossary of graph theory.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
Glossary of graph theory.question: According to _____'s theorem, all simple graphs are either of class one or class two
Glossary of graph theory.fact: In the context of Vizing's theorem, on edge coloring simple graphs, a graph is said to be of class one if its chromatic index equals its maximum degree, and class two if its chromatic index equals one plus the degree. According to Vizing's theorem, all simple graphs are either of class one or class two.

Glossary of graph theory.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
Glossary of graph theory.question: connect _____ to be connected
Glossary of graph theory.fact: connect Cause to be connected.

Glossary of graph theory.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
Glossary of graph theory.question: connected component _____ for component
Glossary of graph theory.fact: connected component Synonym for component.

Glossary of graph theory.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
Glossary of graph theory.question: contraction _____ contraction is an elementary operation that removes an edge from a graph while merging the two vertices that it previously joined
Glossary of graph theory.fact: Higher forms of connectivity include strong connectivity in directed graphs (for each two vertices there are paths from one to the other in both directions), k-vertex-connected graphs (removing fewer than k vertices cannot disconnect the graph), and k-edge-connected graphs (removing fewer than k edges cannot disconnect the graph). contraction Edge contraction is an elementary operation that removes an edge from a graph while merging the two vertices that it previously joined.

Glossary of graph theory.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
Glossary of graph theory.question: In the theory of graph matchings, the core of a graph is an aspect of its _____–Mendelsohn decomposition, formed as the union of all maximum matchings
Glossary of graph theory.fact: In the theory of graph matchings, the core of a graph is an aspect of its Dulmage–Mendelsohn decomposition, formed as the union of all maximum matchings.

Glossary of graph theory.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
Glossary of graph theory.question: Important special types of cycle include _____ cycles, induced cycles, peripheral cycles, and the shortest cycle, which defines the girth of a graph
Glossary of graph theory.fact: Important special types of cycle include Hamiltonian cycles, induced cycles, peripheral cycles, and the shortest cycle, which defines the girth of a graph.

Glossary of graph theory.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
Glossary of graph theory.question: Degeneracy is also known as the k-core number, width, and linkage, and one plus the degeneracy is also called the coloring number or _____–Wilf number
Glossary of graph theory.fact: Degeneracy is also called the k-core number, width, and linkage, and one plus the degeneracy is also called the coloring number or Szekeres–Wilf number.

Glossary of graph theory.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
Glossary of graph theory.question: The homomorphism degree of a graph is a synonym for its _____ number, the order of the largest clique minor
Glossary of graph theory.fact: The homomorphism degree of a graph is a synonym for its Hadwiger number, the order of the largest clique minor.

Glossary of graph theory.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
Glossary of graph theory.question: Δ, δ Δ(G) (using the _____ letter delta) is the maximum degree of a vertex in G, and δ(G) is the minimum degree; see degree
Glossary of graph theory.fact: Δ, δ Δ(G) (using the Greek letter delta) is the maximum degree of a vertex in G, and δ(G) is the minimum degree; see degree.

Glossary of graph theory.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
Glossary of graph theory.question: diconnected _____ connected
Glossary of graph theory.fact: diconnected Strongly connected.

Glossary of graph theory.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
Glossary of graph theory.question: digraph _____ for directed graph
Glossary of graph theory.fact: digraph Synonym for directed graph.

Glossary of graph theory.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
Glossary of graph theory.question: disconnect _____ to be disconnected
Glossary of graph theory.fact: disconnect Cause to be disconnected.

Glossary of graph theory.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
Glossary of graph theory.question: A planar graph is a graph that has such an embedding onto the _____ plane, and a toroidal graph is a graph that has such an embedding onto a torus
Glossary of graph theory.fact: A planar graph is a graph that has such an embedding onto the Euclidean plane, and a toroidal graph is a graph that has such an embedding onto a torus.

Glossary of graph theory.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
Glossary of graph theory.question: An _____ circuit (also called an Eulerian cycle or an Euler tour) is a closed walk that uses every edge exactly once
Glossary of graph theory.fact: Eulerian An Eulerian path is a walk that uses every edge of a graph exactly once. An Eulerian circuit (also called an Eulerian cycle or an Euler tour) is a closed walk that uses every edge exactly once.

Glossary of graph theory.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
Glossary of graph theory.question: An _____ graph is a graph that has an Eulerian circuit
Glossary of graph theory.fact: Eulerian An Eulerian path is a walk that uses every edge of a graph exactly once. An Eulerian circuit (also called an Eulerian cycle or an Euler tour) is a closed walk that uses every edge exactly once.

Glossary of graph theory.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
Glossary of graph theory.question: In some cases, the connectivity requirement is loosened, and a graph meeting only the degree requirements is called _____
Glossary of graph theory.fact: An Eulerian graph is a graph that has an Eulerian circuit. In some cases, the connectivity requirement is loosened, and a graph meeting only the degree requirements is called Eulerian.

Glossary of graph theory.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
Glossary of graph theory.question: even _____ by two; for instance, an even cycle is a cycle whose length is even
Glossary of graph theory.fact: even Divisible by two; for instance, an even cycle is a cycle whose length is even.

Glossary of graph theory.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
Glossary of graph theory.question: greedy _____ by a greedy algorithm
Glossary of graph theory.fact: greedy Produced by a greedy algorithm. For instance, a greedy coloring of a graph is a coloring produced by considering the vertices in some sequence and assigning each vertex the first available color.

Glossary of graph theory.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
Glossary of graph theory.question: A graph is H-minor-free if it does not have a minor isomorphic to H. _____ 1
Glossary of graph theory.fact: A graph is H-minor-free if it does not have a minor isomorphic to H. Hadwiger 1. The Hadwiger number of a graph is the order of the largest complete minor of the graph.

Glossary of graph theory.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
Glossary of graph theory.question: The _____ conjecture is the conjecture that the Hadwiger number is never less than the chromatic number
Glossary of graph theory.fact: A graph is H-minor-free if it does not have a minor isomorphic to H. Hadwiger 1. The Hadwiger number of a graph is the order of the largest complete minor of the graph.

Glossary of graph theory.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
Glossary of graph theory.question: A graph is _____ if it contains a Hamiltonian cycle, and traceable if it contains a Hamiltonian path
Glossary of graph theory.fact: Hamiltonian A Hamiltonian path or Hamiltonian cycle is a simple spanning path or simple spanning cycle: it covers all of the vertices in the graph exactly once. A graph is Hamiltonian if it contains a Hamiltonian cycle, and traceable if it contains a Hamiltonian path.

Glossary of graph theory.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
Glossary of graph theory.question: Havens can be used to characterize the treewidth of finite graphs and the ends and _____ numbers of infinite graphs
Glossary of graph theory.fact: Havens can be used to characterize the treewidth of finite graphs and the ends and Hadwiger numbers of infinite graphs.

Glossary of graph theory.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
Glossary of graph theory.question: For instance, a hypohamiltonian graph is one that does not have a _____ cycle, but for which every one-vertex deletion produces a Hamiltonian subgraph
Glossary of graph theory.fact: For instance, a hypohamiltonian graph is one that does not have a Hamiltonian cycle, but for which every one-vertex deletion produces a Hamiltonian subgraph.

Glossary of graph theory.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
Glossary of graph theory.question: incident (_____) The relation between an edge and one of its endpoints
Glossary of graph theory.fact: incident (Adjective) The relation between an edge and one of its endpoints.

Glossary of graph theory.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
Glossary of graph theory.question: inductive _____ for degenerate
Glossary of graph theory.fact: inductive Synonym for degenerate.

Glossary of graph theory.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
Glossary of graph theory.question: isthmus _____ for bridge, in the sense of an edge whose removal disconnects the graph
Glossary of graph theory.fact: isthmus Synonym for bridge, in the sense of an edge whose removal disconnects the graph.

Glossary of graph theory.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
Glossary of graph theory.question: κ κ(G) (using the _____ letter kappa) can refer to the vertex connectivity of G or to the clique number of G
Glossary of graph theory.fact: κ κ(G) (using the Greek letter kappa) can refer to the vertex connectivity of G or to the clique number of G.

Glossary of graph theory.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
Glossary of graph theory.question: A _____ graph is a graph in which every odd cycle of length five or more has at least two chords
Glossary of graph theory.fact: A Meyniel graph is a graph in which every odd cycle of length five or more has at least two chords.

Glossary of graph theory.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
Glossary of graph theory.question: A family of graphs is minor-closed if it is closed under minors; the _____–Seymour theorem characterizes minor-closed families as having a finite set of forbidden minors
Glossary of graph theory.fact: A family of graphs is minor-closed if it is closed under minors; the Robertson–Seymour theorem characterizes minor-closed families as having a finite set of forbidden minors.

Glossary of graph theory.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
Glossary of graph theory.question: The Moore bound is an inequality relating the degree, diameter, and order of a graph, proved by _____
Glossary of graph theory.fact: The Moore bound is an inequality relating the degree, diameter, and order of a graph, proved by Edward F. Moore.

Glossary of graph theory.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
Glossary of graph theory.question: A perfect 1-factorization is a partition of the edges of a graph into perfect matchings so that each two matchings form a _____ cycle
Glossary of graph theory.fact: A perfect 1-factorization is a partition of the edges of a graph into perfect matchings so that each two matchings form a Hamiltonian cycle.

Glossary of graph theory.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
Glossary of graph theory.question: planar A planar graph is a graph that has an embedding onto the _____ plane
Glossary of graph theory.fact: planar A planar graph is a graph that has an embedding onto the Euclidean plane.

Glossary of graph theory.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
Glossary of graph theory.question: A prime graph for the _____ product of graphs is a connected graph that is not itself a product
Glossary of graph theory.fact: A prime graph for the Cartesian product of graphs is a connected graph that is not itself a product. Every connected graph can be uniquely factored into a Cartesian product of prime graphs.

Glossary of graph theory.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
Glossary of graph theory.question: Every connected graph can be uniquely factored into a _____ product of prime graphs
Glossary of graph theory.fact: A prime graph for the Cartesian product of graphs is a connected graph that is not itself a product. Every connected graph can be uniquely factored into a Cartesian product of prime graphs.

Glossary of graph theory.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
Glossary of graph theory.question: That is, it is a d-regular graph, such that the second-largest eigenvalue of its adjacency matrix is at most _____ d − 1 {\displaystyle 2{\sqrt {d-1}}}
Glossary of graph theory.fact: That is, it is a d-regular graph, such that the second-largest eigenvalue of its adjacency matrix is at most 2 d − 1 {\displaystyle 2{\sqrt {d-1}}}.

Glossary of graph theory.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
Glossary of graph theory.question: searching number _____ searching number is a synonym for pathwidth
Glossary of graph theory.fact: searching number Node searching number is a synonym for pathwidth.

Glossary of graph theory.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
Glossary of graph theory.question: separation number _____ separation number is a synonym for pathwidth
Glossary of graph theory.fact: separating vertex See articulation point. separation number Vertex separation number is a synonym for pathwidth.

Glossary of graph theory.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
Glossary of graph theory.question: The cycle space has the _____ spanning subgraphs as its elements
Glossary of graph theory.fact: The cycle space has the Eulerian spanning subgraphs as its elements.

Glossary of graph theory.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
Glossary of graph theory.question: Thomsen graph _____ graph is a name for the complete bipartite graph K 3 , 3 {\displaystyle K_{3,3}}
Glossary of graph theory.fact: Thomsen graph The Thomsen graph is a name for the complete bipartite graph K 3 , 3 {\displaystyle K_{3,3}}.

Glossary of graph theory.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
Glossary of graph theory.question: totally disconnected _____ for edgeless
Glossary of graph theory.fact: totally disconnected Synonym for edgeless.

Glossary of graph theory.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
Glossary of graph theory.question: Euler tours are tours that use all of the graph edges; see _____
Glossary of graph theory.fact: Euler tours are tours that use all of the graph edges; see Eulerian.

Glossary of graph theory.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
Glossary of graph theory.question: traceable A traceable graph is a graph that contains a _____ path
Glossary of graph theory.fact: traceable A traceable graph is a graph that contains a Hamiltonian path.

Glossary of graph theory.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
Glossary of graph theory.question: transitive _____ to do with the transitive property
Glossary of graph theory.fact: transitive Having to do with the transitive property. A transitive reduction of a graph is a minimal graph having the same transitive closure; directed acyclic graphs have a unique transitive reduction.

Gloster Javelin.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
Gloster Javelin.question: What do you know about The Gloster Javelin?
Gloster Javelin.answer: a twin-engined all-weather interceptor aircraft designed and produced by the Gloster Aircraft Company.
Gloster Javelin.fact: The Gloster Javelin is a twin-engined all-weather interceptor aircraft designed and produced by the Gloster Aircraft Company.

Gloster Javelin.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
Gloster Javelin.question: It was operated by the _____ from the mid-1950s until the late 1960s and was the final aircraft design to bear the Gloster name
Gloster Javelin.fact: It was operated by the Royal Air Force from the mid-1950s until the late 1960s and was the final aircraft design to bear the Gloster name.

Gloster Javelin.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
Gloster Javelin.question: It was a T-tailed delta-wing aircraft powered by a pair of _____ turbojet engines
Gloster Javelin.fact: It was a T-tailed delta-wing aircraft powered by a pair of Armstrong Siddeley Sapphire turbojet engines.

Gloster Javelin.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
Gloster Javelin.question: Following a protracted development period, the Javelin was introduced to squadron service during _____
Gloster Javelin.fact: Following a protracted development period, the Javelin was introduced to squadron service during 1956.

Gloster Javelin.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
Gloster Javelin.question: During its service life, it received upgrades to its engines, radar and weapons, which included the _____ air-to-air missile
Gloster Javelin.fact: During its service life, it received upgrades to its engines, radar and weapons, which included the De Havilland Firestreak air-to-air missile.

Gloster Javelin.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
Gloster Javelin.question: The Javelin was replaced in the interceptor role by the _____, a supersonic aircraft capable of flying at more than double the speed of the Javelin
Gloster Javelin.fact: The Javelin was replaced in the interceptor role by the English Electric Lightning, a supersonic aircraft capable of flying at more than double the speed of the Javelin.

Gloster Javelin.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
Gloster Javelin.question: The Javelin had a relatively short service life, the last examples were withdrawn from operational service in _____ following the phased-in introduction of the Lightning
Gloster Javelin.fact: The Javelin had a relatively short service life, the last examples were withdrawn from operational service in 1968 following the phased-in introduction of the Lightning.

Gloster Javelin.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
Gloster Javelin.question: In _____, the Air Ministry issued a requirement for a high-performance night fighter under specification F.44/46
Gloster Javelin.fact: In 1947, the Air Ministry issued a requirement for a high-performance night fighter under specification F.44/46.

Gloster Javelin.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
